rules.statement: A notary can be an attesting witness even if he does not know the executant personally, but proof of execution of the deed is incomplete on his evidence alone.
rules.supporting_quote: It is in that context the Court held that the notary was not an attesting witness. This should not be understood to mean that a notary can never be an attesting witness unless he knows the executant personally.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance
